facts.fact: Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation Avinash Ramtohul spoke on 16 July 2026 of the government's commitment to digital governance through the implementation of a National Data Governance Strategy, presenting it as in implementation; the document gives no approval or launch date.

note: One passing ministerial mention of implementing a National Data Governance Strategy; no body or rule tied to it. Amendments to the Data Protection Act are class other.

Describes an ICT sector strategy in preparation with data protection central, and a call for a citizen data hub; a sector or digital strategy and data protection are class other, and no national data policy is named.

facts.fact: Minister Ramtohul said the National Data Strategy (2025-2029) guides Government, people and businesses on how to handle and process data.
The Minister said the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner has finalised a national data strategy on data sharing, governance and protection, with no adoption stated.
